# Know what customers want. Show them you listened.

> Collect feature requests, let customers vote, catch duplicates as they type, publish a roadmap and a changelog with RSS. One small open-source server you run yourself. Free, MIT, no per-user fee. Try the duplicate finder in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
